entities.name: Additional information
entities.description: The Additional information information element provides additional information to upper layers in relation to the generic NAS message transport mechanism. It is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 3 octets.

entities.name: Additional information IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier for Additional information, located in octet 1.

entities.name: Additional information length
entities.description: Length of the Additional information field, located in octet 2.

entities.name: Additional information value
entities.description: The coding of the additional information value is dependent on the generic message container type, located in octets 3 to n.

entities.name: Generic message container type dependency
entities.description: The coding of the additional information value is dependent on the generic message container type.

relations.description: The Additional information IE contains the IEI field.
